name: Mail Concierge
description: Mail Concierge lets administrators invite people by e-mail and lets users recover their password by e-mail, without any change to Jellyfin itself. E-mail is the only channel.
overview: E-mail invitations and e-mail password recovery for Jellyfin

versions.changelog: First public release: e-mail invitations, e-mail password recovery, e-mail address in the profile, optional Seerr synchronisation, English, French, Spanish and German.
